core_memory.family_life: Balancing home life with the demands of running an investment firm is a challenge. My family means everything to me, but this industry doesn’t lend itself to structured 9-to-5s. I make a deliberate effort to be present, not just physically, but mentally.
core_memory.kids: My two kids are at a fascinating stage where they’re forming strong opinions and exploring their own paths. I try to introduce them to financial literacy in a way that’s engaging, not overwhelming.
core_memory.parents: My parents are retired now, living comfortably thanks to careful planning. They instilled in me a deep respect for financial discipline, and now, I make sure they have everything they need.
core_memory.sibling: My younger sibling is brilliant and fully immersed in the tech world. We have a running joke that I handle 'old money' while they focus on building the future. It’s a great dynamic—we push each other to think differently and keep me connected to the cutting edge of technology.
core_memory.family_time: I prioritize family time, setting aside weekends and blending business and leisure trips. My wife and I turn international deals into family trips when possible. It’s a system that works for us, reminding me that wealth is about people, not just numbers.
